name: Hoboken
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hoboken, NJ 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Hoboken, NJ for 2026: city tree lighting, menorah lighting, Santa photos on Pier 13, a family party and gingerbread fun.
lede: Hoboken celebrates in the shadow of the Manhattan skyline, with a city tree lighting on Washington Street, a firetruck gelt drop at the menorah lighting and Santa photos on the Hudson waterfront.
celebrates: The City of Hoboken marks the season with community celebrations that start with the menorah lighting at City Hall on December 6 and the Holiday Tree Lighting at 11th and Washington Street on December 10, hosted with the Hoboken Business Alliance. The city adds a Holiday Hop shuttle on December weekends from 11 am to 6 pm, a police department toy drive and discounted garage parking for shoppers. Families can also see Santa on Pier 13, where Pier One Tree sells Christmas trees beside the Hudson, and join the Hoboken Family Alliance's holiday party at The Hoboken Biergarten.
lastyear: The City of Hoboken's 2025 holiday announcement set the Christmas tree lighting for Thursday, December 11 at 5 pm at 11th and Washington Streets. It described performances by Elvis the Elf and school choruses, live ice carving, carousel rides, a holiday DJ dance party and a visit from Santa, with free hot chocolate and cookies from The Hive and glow sticks from Apple Montessori Schools. The Hoboken Historical Museum also led its annual holiday caroling through uptown Hoboken on December 16, 2025.
facts: Hoboken's tree lighting is a neighborhood affair run by the city and the Hoboken Business Alliance, and the city closes 11th Street and part of Washington Street so families can gather in the roadway. The Hoboken Historical Museum has an annual tradition of caroling through uptown Hoboken, and the Hoboken Family Alliance puts its ticket proceeds into a holiday gift program that gives presents to local families in need. The menorah lighting ends with a chocolate gelt drop from a Hoboken Fire Department truck.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Hoboken itself, and the city's tree lighting page points families toward NJ Transit buses on Bloomfield and Hudson Streets rather than a holiday train. Our New Jersey guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-new-jersey lists the Christmas train rides across the state, including The Polar Express in Phillipsburg, which runs on weekends from November 27 to December 20, 2026.
traditions: The city and the Hoboken Business Alliance light the tree at 11th and Washington Street with school choirs, dancers and a visit from Santa.
A family friendly ceremony co-hosted by Chabad of Hoboken and Jersey City, with a chocolate gelt drop from a fire truck.
Pier One Tree on Pier 13 lists Santa Claus photos, a Coco cart and face painting on three Saturdays.
The city's free Holiday Hop shuttle runs on December weekends from 11 am to 6 pm.
The Hoboken Historical Museum leads neighbors on a holiday caroling walk each December.
kidfact: At the Hoboken menorah lighting, a fire truck drops chocolate gelt for the kids.
faq: The City of Hoboken holds a menorah lighting at City Hall on December 6 and the Holiday Tree Lighting at 11th and Washington Street on December 10. Families can also visit Santa on Pier 13, attend the Hoboken Family Alliance holiday party and ride the free Holiday Hop shuttle on December weekends.
Is there a free Christmas event in Hoboken?

Yes. The Hoboken Menorah Lighting Ceremony at City Hall is free, and the city runs its Holiday Hop shuttle for shoppers at no charge. The city's tree lighting page does not print a price, so check the city before you go.
Where can kids meet Santa in Hoboken?

Santa visits the Holiday Tree Lighting on December 10, appears at the Hoboken Family Alliance holiday party on December 3 and is listed for photos at Pier One Tree on Pier 13 on three Saturdays, November 28, December 5 and December 12. Each host lists its own hours.
Can we make gingerbread houses in Hoboken?

Di Blu Bakery holds a Christmas family event on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 11 am to 12:30 pm where each guest builds a gingerbread house, decorates cookies and writes a letter to Santa. Tickets are $40 for a child and $50 for an adult.
Which Hoboken streets close for the tree lighting?

The city says 11th Street between Hudson and Bloomfield closes at 3 pm on December 10 and Washington Street between 10th and 12th closes at about 4 pm. NJ Transit buses run on Bloomfield and Hudson Streets until the roads reopen at about 8 pm.
